observations: Three photos show the same disassembled automatic transmission/transfer-case assembly lying on bare dirt ground, taken from slightly different angles.
A watermark reading 'POSTED ON JIJI GEARUP INC.' appears on each photo.
No manufacturer tag, part number, or VIN sticker is legible on the casing in any photo.
The unit shows dirt, oxidation, and old grease/oil residue; wiring harness connectors are dangling and disconnected.
A driveshaft yoke/transfer-case bell housing is visible, consistent with a 4WD-capable transmission, but no badge confirms make or model.
Other partially visible transmissions and an engine block are stacked in the background, suggesting a scrapyard/parts-dealer setting.
No fluid level, pan bolts, or internal gear condition can be seen; the unit is not running or being tested in any shot.

No part tag, casting number, or badge in photo 0, 1, or 2 confirms Ford or Expedition-specific casting.
Transfer case bell housing shape in photo 0 is consistent with a 4WD unit, but no plate confirms V8 output shaft spec or bolt pattern.
